title.value: Functional specialization within the inferior parietal lobes across cognitive domains
title.justification: The title directly reflects the focus of the study on functional specialization in the inferior parietal lobes related to different cognitive domains, as evidenced in the text.
title.quote: Functional specialization within the inferior parietal lobes across cognitive domains

analysis.description: This study investigates how different cognitive tasks related to attention, semantics, and social cognition evoke functional specializations in the inferior parietal lobes (IPL) using neuroimaging and multivariate pattern-learning algorithms.

type.justification: The study involves empirical investigation using neuroimaging and data analysis methods to explore functional specialization within the IPL during cognitive tasks.
type.quote: Across attentional, semantic, and social cognitive tasks, our study explored functional specialization within the IPL.

name.justification: The paper focuses on exploring brain functions and connectivity, placing it within the field of neuroscience.
The study examines cognitive processes related to attentional, semantic, and social cognitive tasks, characteristic of cognitive neuroscience.
name.quote: Cognitive neuroimaging experiments that tap on multiple functional domains.

name.justification: The logistic predictive model was used to classify task membership based on neural activity changes in IPL subregions.
name.quote: The logistic predictive model was cross-validated in a one-versus-rest scheme to attempt classifying trial brain scans from hold-out subjects.

is_contributed.justification: The model is used as a tool rather than being a novel contribution of the study.
is_contributed.quote: By deploying a linear predictive pattern-learning algorithm, we solved the classification problem of assigning task-membership from single experimental trials based on the subregion-level neural activity changes.

is_executed.justification: The model was executed to analyze and classify neuroimaging data.
is_executed.quote: The logistic predictive model was cross-validated... to attempt classifying trial brain scans from hold-out subjects.

is_compared.justification: The performance of the model was evaluated using cross-validation techniques, comparing predicted to actual outcomes.
is_compared.quote: The logistic predictive model was cross-validated in a one-versus-rest scheme to attempt classifying trial brain scans from hold-out subjects.
